brief: An island-town cottage lot: Capt Minch House, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Capt. Minch House (Vermilion): a two-storey gable-front Greek Revival house with a cornice return and frieze, green shutters, a small paired attic window, a side-hall door up steps; flagstone stepping stones across the lawn; big trees

why.note: Vermilion OH: Lake Erie ship captains' houses of the 1840s-80s (the 'village of lake captains')
